violations.text: Walk-in cooler was observed held at 47 degrees Fahrenheit. Foods in this unit observed with temperatures of 45 degrees F. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Several foods had been out of the walk-in cooler for approximately 1 hour as the unit was being rearranged for repair. TCS foods were evaluated and deemed safe. Service is currently on-site to repair the issue. Walk-in freezer door had been opened periodically to decrease walk-in cooler temperature. Walk-in freezer door is to remain open and food temperatures are to be carefully monitored until walk-in cooler has been repaired and is maintaining a consistent temperature at/below 41 degrees F. Ambient temperature of the walk-in cooler observed at 41 degrees F at the end of inspection (with walk-in freezer door left open). New Violation. Correct By: 09/22/2026

The receiving door is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 09/07/2024

Cover to steam table pan observed on the hand-washing sink at the service line. A hand-washing sink must not be used for purposes other than hand washing. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 03/10/2026

Proper cooling methods were not used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. Pasta was placed in the walk-in cooler in covered containers greater than four inches deep. Pasta was uncovered and divided into smaller amounts during inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 03/10/2026
